LightningComponentBundle.description: Single header-region drop combining the logo, Navigation Menu, and notification bell

property.name: logoUrl
property.label: Logo Image URL
property.description: URL or static resource path to the logo image, e.g. /resource/PartnerSync_Logo. Leave blank to show the text wordmark instead.

property.name: wordmark
property.label: Wordmark Text
property.description: Text shown when no logo image is set, and used as the logo link's accessible label either way

property.name: homePageName
property.label: Home Page Name
property.description: Experience Builder page API name the logo links to. Leave blank to make the logo non-clickable.

property.name: menuName
property.label: Navigation Menu Name
property.description: The name of the Navigation Menu Linkset, which can be configured in Settings > Navigation

property.name: buttonLabel
property.label: Button Label
property.description: Optional call-to-action button label shown after the menu. Leave blank to hide the button.

property.name: buttonRedirectPageAPIName
property.label: Button Redirect Page Name
property.description: Experience Builder page API name the call-to-action button navigates to
